to: the sender (a copy) and the recipient, on any server

variants.name: To the recipient
variants.when: The recipient is on the same server as the sender.

variants.name: From another server
variants.when: The recipient is on another server. That server runs the emit through `server_eval_direct`. `id` is the name of the sender.

variants.name: Copy to the sender
variants.when: Always first, before the server looks for the recipient. `xserver` is `true` when the recipient is not on this server.

variants.name: Delivery failed
variants.when: No character has the name `to`. The sender gets it after its copy.

PmMessage.summary: A private message, or the copy of it that the sender gets.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Only in the copy of the sender: the recipient name, as the sender wrote it in `say`.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The text, at most 1,200 characters. The server removes some characters first (`strip_string`).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the sender: the character name. From the web Communicator it is `"comm:"` plus the database id of the character (api.js:1195), except on another server.

fields.name: xserver
fields.description: The recipient is not on this server: in the copy of the sender, or in the message from another server.

PmDeliveryFailed.summary: A notice to the sender: no character has the name of the recipient.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The name of the sender: you.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The recipient name, as you wrote it.

senders.what: `deliver_chat_message` with a recipient name: the `say` handler with `name`, or a private message from the web Communicator (`communicator_say`; then the sender gets no copy).
The server of the recipient, through `server_eval_direct`.
